The Story Behind the Bowl

From Japan, With Love. 

Kei Kaisendon was born in 2017, inspired by a founder’s unforgettable trip to Japan. After falling in love with the taste of authentic Kaisendon—a hearty bowl of fresh sashimi over rice—she came home and couldn’t find the same magic.

Driven by passion, she recreated that experience in Singapore. Every bowl we serve is crafted with the freshest seafood, premium ingredients, and a whole lot of heart—just like in Japan!

Kei Kaisendon is more than a meal.
It’s a taste of tradition, made with love.

Order now (take away & delivery)

Discover Kaisendon

Kaisendon (海鮮丼) is a traditional Japanese rice bowl topped with fresh, sashimi-grade seafood.
The name means “seafood bowl,” and that’s exactly what it is—colorful, nourishing, and full of umami.

Served over vinegared rice and paired with wasabi, soy sauce, or house-made sauces, Kaisendon is a staple in Japan’s coastal towns.

At Kei Kaisendon, we bring you this authentic taste using only premium ingredients and a whole lot of heart.

instore menu

Kei Kaisendon:
The Essence of Japanese Craftsmanship

Founded in 2017, Kei Kaisendon has won prestigious awards for 4 consecutive years, showcasing its profound heritage and exceptional quality.

The brand originated from a fishing village in Hokkaido. Founder Kei, with a deep affection for the sea, established the brand with the aim of spreading the true essence of Japanese cuisine, incorporating humanistic care and warmth to let diners fully enjoy the true taste. Kei’s original intention is to convey the unique enjoyment of fresh seafood flavors.

The secret of “Strictly controlling the freshness of ingredients, and crafting exquisite flavors” – selecting fresh salmon from Norwegian waters, and fresh farm vegetables, paired with the founder’s secret Kei sauce, blending with the richness of rice. Every bite is an intertwining of the essence of the sea and land.
